evals.prompt: What is a Drive ID for the Kei Google Drive connector, and how do I find it?
evals.expected_output: A Drive ID is the optional drive_id field that scopes the Kei connector to one Google shared drive; kei-proxy supplies it as the drive scope on Drive calls. Blank means the connecting user's My Drive plus every shared drive they can access. Find it by opening the shared drive in Google Drive (left nav: Shared drives); the ID is the last URL segment of the drive's folders URL. Shared drive IDs start with 0A; ordinary folder IDs usually start with 1 and are not drive IDs.
